words: The user's own words about the subject, the angle and the look, verbatim.
ch01 feedback: later words that changed the bar, with the film they came from.
angle: The one thing a viewer should leave with, and what must be in the film (a scene, a quote, an ending)

look.pictures: print for paintings and photographs, line for clean engravings; a drawing that draws itself on once or twice

music: public-domain classical recordings, one per part of the film, changing at the turns

pacing.turns: one argument with five or six turns; one idea or picture every two to four seconds

approved.why: close-ups on what is named; few words on screen
